    Pretorsion theories with a fixed intersection #

    Proposition 3.8. For every subcategory Z, the pretorsion theories with T ∩ F = Z are closed under nonempty meets (sInf_middle) and joins (sSup_middle). For the meet, with T = ⋂ Tᵢ, the subcategory F_Z = {Y : t_T(Y) ∈ Z} (fixedF) is a second component with (T, F_Z) a pretorsion theory containing every Fᵢ (Lemma 3.7), so the meet lies between (T, Fᵢ) and (T, F_Z). Joins follow by duality.
